subject: Physics
b6_reason: Motor must overcome weight plus friction (23000 N) at 1.5 m/s, giving P = 23000 x 1.5 = 34500 W.
b6_working: Constant speed => net force zero. F_motor = mg + f = 2000*10 + 3000 = 20000 + 3000 = 23000 N. P = F*v = 23000 * 1.5 = 34500 W.
b6_note: Option 1 (23000) is the force in newtons, a plausible distractor for anyone who omits the velocity factor.
